planets.name: K2-384 e
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-384 with a 9.72-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: K2-384 e was found in 2022 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 5 planets known around K2-384. Its orbit and size follow Christiansen et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
